thread.gist: Booking AER-7T3M1B: AK220 Manchester–Rome cancelled. Five passengers affected. Chidi and wife Adaeze (and son Emeka, 9) need to get to Rome by Friday evening. Mother Ngozi (71) uses a wheelchair and had assistance booked both directions; assistance must move with any rebooking; she may cancel if the earliest alternative is Friday but they want to see options first. Brother-in-law Tobias Achebe no longer wants to travel and wants a refund. Complaint that since 05:00 at Manchester no one offered a drink or told them where to go.

requests.ask: Rebook them to get to Rome by Friday evening (any option that arrives by Friday evening is acceptable).
If rebooking Ngozi, ensure the booked assistance (booked both directions) is transferred to the new flight; she cannot be left without assistance.
Present options for Ngozi (including cancellation) — she would rather cancel and stay at home if the earliest alternative is Friday, but they want to see options before deciding.
Refund his ticket; he does not wish to travel.

Provide duty-of-care assistance at Manchester immediately (e.g. refreshments, and clear guidance where to go), as they have been sitting since 05:00 with a 9-year-old and an elderly passenger and no one has offered help.

most_recent_intention: Rebook Chidi, Adaeze and Emeka to arrive Rome by Friday evening; ensure assistance is transferred for Ngozi (or present options including cancellation); refund Tobias Achebe; provide immediate duty-of-care assistance at Manchester (refreshments/info).
summary: Passenger Chidi Okonkwo (booking AER-7T3M1B) reports AK220 Manchester–Rome cancelled. Requests rebooking for him, his wife Adaeze and son Emeka to arrive by Friday evening; insists assistance for elderly mother Ngozi (wheelchair user) be transferred to any new flight (or show options including cancellation); requests a refund for Tobias Achebe; complains no duty-of-care (drinks/info) was offered at Manchester.
